free_tier_limits.correction: Tenderly Free includes Explorer, Debugger, and single-transaction simulation in the browser. It does not include API or Node RPC access.

rate_limits.correction: Current public documentation does not publish plan-specific rate-limit quotas. Node RPC is paid-only and metered using per-method Tenderly Unit costs; customers must contact sales to discuss capacity and limits.

description.correction: Tenderly provides the listed simulation, debugging, Node RPC, Virtual Environment, and monitoring capabilities. However, API access tokens are personal-account or organization tokens, not project-scoped keys. REST paths commonly identify account and project slugs, while Node RPC access keys are embedded in gateway URLs.

notes: The REST base URL, X-Access-Key authentication, and simulation example remain current. The material errors concern the 2026 commercial model: Free has no API or Node RPC access, current team pricing has no public plan tiers or quotas, and access tokens are account- or organization-level rather than project-scoped.
